description: Creates a part from the user's default part template (or a named template) and makes it the active document. With path, saves it there at once. The part is the agent's own, so document.close may close it.

type.description: What to create; only part in this version. Default part.

template.description: Full path of a part template (.PRTDOT); the user's default part template when absent.

path.description: Full path of a .SLDPRT file that does not exist yet, in an existing folder: the new part is saved there at once.
